value: International Energy Agency (2025). Energy Management for Industry: Driving efficiency implementation. Energy Efficiency Implementation Drive, IEA, Paris, 2025. Prepared by the Office of Energy Efficiency and Inclusive Transitions (V. Rozite, E. Mooney et al.).

BACKGROUND ONLY - no extraction. What it is and why no data: Policy and practice report on energy management systems (ISO 50001), energy audits and programme design, with country case studies and survey findings. Savings are stated at company or programme level (percent of energy use), not per technology or per unit of product. What it does have: Programme-level energy savings from EnMS and audit schemes in several countries; industrial energy-intensity improvement rates 2010-2023; policy design guidance. No capex, efficiency or specific energy consumption for any technology.
